shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a green shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat and asks whether tea should be served with sugar, while a man in a white shirt sits in the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt enters and sits in the patio-side window seat. He answers that sugar is unwanted, and a woman in a green shirt replies that sugar is customary.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt asks about milk preference.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
